content:
maya: Quick AM async — prewarm update and a couple of asks.
aj: Thanks — what's the current status for the AMS / EU warm pool?
maya: kicked off prewarm for rtx-a100 pool around now. initial request = 120 GPUs, cloud returned 118 ready, 2 pending.
aj: I see some errors in the provisioning logs: `QuotaCheckError: Exceeded resource quota for GPUs in eu-west1`.
kevin: that's the quota we expected to be tight. I enabled region fallback (eu-west4) to avoid customer impact — set spill policy to 20% capacity.
ops-bot: Prewarm job submitted: job-id=prewarm-2712345678, requested=120, regions=[ams1,eu-west1], started=2712345678
maya: I filed a Cloud support request for eu-west1 GPU quota increase (ref 12345). ETA listed as 6-8 hours but I asked for escalation.
aj: can you paste the quick command you used to check quotas? will run from my side too.
maya: sure — run:
```
gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --project=redwood-inference
gcloud compute quotas list --project=redwood-inference --filter="metric:GPUs"
```
kevin: temporary mitigation steps: 1) routing policy updated to prefer ams1, 2) fallback to eu-west4 for 20% spill, 3) prewarm will auto-retry pending nodes for 10m.
tess: blocker: my PR to add the prewarm manager IAM role (infra/prewarm) is awaiting one more approval — that role change is needed for the retry logic to create instances in eu-west4.
liam: I've approved the CR just now. pls rebase if needed.
maya: thanks liam — rebase done. ops-bot, any status on warm nodes?
ops-bot: Prewarm job status: requested=120, ready=118, pending=2, last_update=2712345805
aj: ETA for full readiness? need to update PLG on traffic routing expectations.
maya: ETA ~12m for VM boot + ~5m for image provisioning. so ~17m from start. throughput estimate once ready: ~200 req/s for 8k context aggregated across the pool (approx).
kevin: if quota doesn't increase by EOD we'll route non-critical traffic to dedicated us-east1 as discussed earlier.
aj: noted. I'll hold off on large model rollouts until warm pool is stable.
maya: monitoring — watch metrics `gpu_pool_ready` and `prewarm_failures`. I'll post a quick screenshot in #eng-infra-alerts when we hit 95% ready.
ops-bot: Prewarm job completed: job-id=prewarm-2712345678, ready=118/120, completed_at=2712345895
maya: closing the loop — 118 is acceptable for this run. no additional blockers from infra side.
kevin: pinging plat-svc to follow up on quota escalation (cc @platform-svc).
aj: thanks all, will update PLG and keep a note for evening rota.
kevin: :thumbsup:
maya: any follow-ups? if not, I'm going offline for a few hours but will monitor alerts.
aj: ack.
